queries.name: inventory
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts) accounts,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media) media,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM media_snapshots) mediaSnapshots,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account_snapshots) accountSnapshots,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments) comments,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment_collections) commentCollections,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collection_jobs) jobs,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collection_jobs WHERE status='running') runningJobs,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account_insights) accountInsights,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM instagram_http_attempts) receipts,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collection_schedules WHERE enabled=1) enabledSchedules,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collection_policy_history) policyIntervals,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment_webhook_events) webhookEvents,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM instagram_metric_support) supportCacheEntries

receiptOrigins.method: Recompute SHA256-derived operation UUID for each existing job.id:page, including its next page. Export aggregates only. Epoch is receipt retention/counter epoch, not 24h. Wall duration sums HTTP waiting, not Worker CPU.

multiAccountSelectionCounterexample.method: Synthetic in-memory SQLite, same WHERE/ORDER BY as nextSchedule; all other A due times future and no jobs. This proves head selection, not an observed production incident.
multiAccountSelectionCounterexample.consequence: tick sees only A schedule; selectWork rejects future A candidate and no retryAt is advanced, so B remains hidden until a later A obligation.

profileRecalculation.method: Independently sum raw CDP timeDeltas excluding idle; sampled local active time is not billed production CPU.

collectionObligations.note: This endpoint describes analysis coverage. Recorded policy obligations are available in get_collection_status; missing analysis observations are not missed jobs.
